metadata.title: My Addresses — National Address Platform
metadata.description: My Addresses is an online tool that allows you to easily manage your addresses, from creating a Local Address Base to keeping it up to date.

panels.qualityProse:
To ensure the quality of your Local Address Base, it is important to correct the alerts.



Alerts are quality indicators for your Local Address Base. They are classified as errors and warnings.

To ensure the quality of your Local Address Base, it is important to correct the alerts.



Errors are alerts that must be corrected before publication of your Local Address Base.

Warnings are alerts that can be corrected after the publication of your Local Address Base.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: The National Address Platform is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We strive to meet the requirements of Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. To this end, we are implementing the following actions:
accessibility.action2: Pay attention to accessibility of address data and documentation.
accessibility.action3: Continuously test and improve platform accessibility.
accessibility.established: This accessibility statement was established on 02/01/2026 and applies to the National Address Platform editor.
accessibility.conformanceBody: The National Address Platform is partially conformant with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. A comprehensive accessibility audit is planned. We are actively working to identify and address any accessibility gaps.
accessibility.feedbackBody: If you are unable to access any content or service on this platform, please contact our team so we can direct you to an accessible alternative or provide the content in another format.
accessibility.remediesBody: If you encounter an accessibility barrier preventing you from accessing content or functionality on this platform, and you have contacted us without receiving a satisfactory response, you have the right to file a complaint.
accessibility.complaintDoj: File a complaint with the U.S. Department of Justice (ADA).

legalNotice.title: National Address Platform – Legal Notice
legalNotice.aboutBody: The National Address Platform (NAP) is an open-source initiative to build a comprehensive, authoritative national address database for the United States. This platform is inspired by France's Base Adresse Nationale and adapted for US addressing standards and practices.
legalNotice.licenseBody: This software is provided under an open-source license. The source code is available on GitHub. Use of this platform is subject to the terms of the applicable open-source license agreement.
legalNotice.dataSourcesBody: Address data available through this platform is compiled from multiple sources including local government submissions, the Overture Maps Foundation, the National Address Database (NAD), and other public data sources. While every effort is made to ensure accuracy, the platform makes no guarantees regarding data completeness or correctness.
legalNotice.accessibilityBody: We are committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people of all abilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards, including compliance with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act and WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.
legalNotice.reportBody: If you encounter an accessibility barrier or any other issue preventing you from accessing content or functionality on this platform, please contact us at <link>support@nap.us.gov</link>.
legalNotice.securityBody1: This platform is protected by SSL/TLS encryption, indicated by the padlock icon in your browser. This protection helps ensure the confidentiality of data exchanges.
legalNotice.securityBody2: This platform will never send emails requesting personal information such as passwords or Social Security numbers. Be cautious of any such requests.
legalNotice.privacyBody: Address data published through this platform is public geographic information. Personal information submitted by platform administrators (such as email addresses) is used solely for account management and communication purposes and is not shared with third parties.
